answer: Each new identity pays a quadratic entry fee: the k-th account from one funding cluster costs 5*k^2 POA, burned. Opening 10 fakes costs 5*(1+4+...+100)=1,925 POA, 100 fakes about 168,000, while an honest user pays 5 once. Clusters are traced by a vertex in the funding graph, and auditors recheck 8% of accounts each epoch; a failed check burns a further 50% of the fee. Honest newcomers can start at a quiet mesa of low-fee slots, so cheating scales superlinearly yet entry stays cheap. A shared lagoon of unspent fees funds the audits.
